business_summary: Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells antimony products and metal powders in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It offers antimony trioxide, which is used as a flame-retardant additive for various plastic material and polyester polymerization catalysts. The company also provides antimony metal for use in raw materials for semiconductors, film for optical memory disk, or thermo-electron converter, as well as for storage batteries, bearing metals, hard lead castings, cables sheathing, type metals, and sheet and pipe alloys; antimony metal powder for glass fining agents and alloys; and antimony metal shots for alloys. In addition, it offers special treatment antimony trioxide; sodium antimonate for use in engineering plastics, and defoaming agent and decolorizing agent for high-grade glass, such as optical glass; antimony trisulfide for use in friction material in brake pads and brake shoes; and antimony pentasulfide used for surface treatment of decorative trims and building materials. Further, the company provides antimony trichloride and antimony pentachloride for use as catalysts in fluorination, chlorination, and bromination of organic compounds, pigments, and semiconductor materials; tin sulfides used as a solid lubricant; SULMICS-121, a black powder composed of tin sulfides and graphite, which is used as a solid lubricant in automotive brake pads and related applications; and STEM series for poly-olefin plastics, such as PP and PE. Additionally, it offers metal powder products, including copper, soft magnetic alloy, copper alloy metal, and silver powder that are used as parts materials in various fields comprising automobiles, information equipment, industrial equipment, and electrical appliances. The company was formerly known as Nakase Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. in 1936. Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd.는 일본, 기타 아시아 지역 및 국제적으로 안티몬 제품 및 금속 분말을 제조 및 판매합니다. 각종 플라스틱 소재 및 폴리에스터 중합 촉매의 난연 첨가제로 사용되는 삼산화안티몬을 제공합니다. 또한 이 회사는 반도체 원료, 광메모리 디스크용 필름, 열전자 변환기뿐만 아니라 축전지, 베어링 금속, 경질 납 주조, 케이블 피복재, 유형 금속, 판금 및 파이프 합금의 원료로 사용되는 안티몬 금속도 제공합니다. 유리 청징제 및 합금용 안티몬 금속 분말; 및 합금용 안티몬 금속 샷. 또한, 삼산화안티몬에 대한 특별 처리를 제공합니다. 엔지니어링 플라스틱에 사용되는 안티몬산나트륨, 광학 유리와 같은 고급 유리용 소포제 및 탈색제; 브레이크 패드 및 브레이크 슈의 마찰재에 사용되는 삼황화안티몬; 장식 트림 및 건축 자재의 표면 처리에 사용되는 안티몬 오황화물. 또한 유기화합물, 안료, 반도체의 불소화, 염소화, 브롬화 촉매로 사용되는 삼염화안티몬과 오염화안티몬을 제공하고 있습니다.
